about: The evangelium of the formulary “9th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, as Jesus drew near to Jerusalem, seeing the city, He wept over it, saying: If only you too had known, and indeed on this day of yours, the things that lead to your peace! But now they have been hidden from your eyes. For days will come upon you, and your enemies will encircle you with a palisade, and surround you, and hem you in from every side, and cast you down to the earth, you and your children who are in you, and they will not leave in you stone upon stone, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation. And entering the temple, He began to drive out those who sold in it and those who bought, saying to them: It is written: My house is a house of prayer. But you have made it a den of robbers. And He was teaching daily in the temple.
